text:
Predicates:
Striker(x) ::: x is a striker.
SoccerPlayer(x) ::: x is a soccer player.
Left(x, y) ::: x left team y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for team y.

Premises:
Striker(x) → SoccerPlayer(x) ::: Strikers are soccer players.
Left(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunchen) ::: Robert Lewandowski left Bayern Munchen.
∀x (Left(x, y) → ¬PlaysFor(x, y)) ::: If a player left a team they no longer play for that team.

Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(RobertLewandowski, BayernMunchen) ::: Robert Lewandowski no longer plays for Bayern Munchen.
